free_tier_limits: Builder tier: no monthly program fee; Core API calls are unmetered and uncharged; up to 500,000 CorePlus calls per workspace per month. Further CorePlus calls are blocked. Sandbox calls are not metered.
rate_limits: REST (sandbox and production): 500 requests/minute per realm ID and 10 requests/second per realm ID/app. Batch: 40 requests/minute per realm ID/app and 120/minute per realm ID.
